summary.en: A Chrome extension that lets you run multiple Claude Code / Codex sessions side-by-side in separate windows — compare approaches, test alternatives, or keep context separate without losing your place.
summary.jp: 複数の Claude Code / Codex セッションを、別々のウィンドウで並行実行できる Chrome 拡張機能。アプローチの比較、別案の検証、文脈を切り離しながらも作業位置を保つ。

mine: Built a Chrome extension that manages multiple AI coding sessions in separate browser windows
Designed window management to preserve context and history across parallel sessions
Created documentation and examples for multi-window AI development workflows

cardKind.jp: Chrome 拡張機能 · Claude · Codex · MIT

cardLine.en: Run multiple Claude Code sessions side-by-side in separate windows.
cardLine.jp: 複数の Claude Code セッションを、別ウィンドウで並行実行。
